what: MAG v2 (per-slot dead-click gate) + DODUO v2 (pair gate) — the tests and the bars. AMENDED 2026-09-25 after the first confirmation run, which is reported, not discarded: seed 2 on commit ff4a6cba scored 1,995 of 1,998 (99.85%), all three losses shown futile by their replays, but its ablation found 57 joints the pair gate cut on a click MAG had called dead — two gate defects (MAG's worlds were a thinner design than the pair gate's; a mega click's pass counterfactual dropped the mega) — and a world defect (an empty opposing slot compacted). Fixed and tested; the confirmation is re-run on a FRESH draw, seed 3. Development: every decision drawn with seeds 1 and 2. The DODUO-greedy arena played once on ff4a6cba through machamp/gate.js (346 games: the frozen store holds 173 test pairs, not 200) is a development run; both arenas are re-run below through sprt.js, which cycles the test pairs on fresh battle seeds.

survival.sample: 2,000 fully observed joint decisions by TEST-split players (the split every solver net uses), both brought fours complete, seeded stride over the dataset
survival.bar: the human's actual joint action survives BOTH gates (MAG not dead on either click, the pair gate does not cut the joint) in >= 99.9% of evaluated decisions (point estimate), AND every loss is explained by reading the replay: a loss is a gate error unless the replay shows the click was futile in the real game
survival.also_reported: the fraction of per-slot options MAG calls dead / soft; the fraction of legal joints each gate removes; the 2x2 of MAG-cut x pair-cut; the pair-cut clicks' MAG verdicts; decisions unmatched (a human action the world could not offer) and errors, each with its reason

arms.x: DODUO v1 argmax over the gated candidates (soft weight 1e-3)
arms.y: DODUO v1 argmax over every legal joint (the ladder bot's current policy)

doduo_greedy.bar: read once, at the SPRT bound or at 400 games: H1 = the gated arm is stronger by the +20 Elo alternative; H0 = it is not; neither = INCONCLUSIVE, reported with the score and its Wilson 95% interval

arms.x: MILTANK with the champion nets (gen5 DODUO prior, gen5 PORYGON2 leaf), 1,000 ms, k 4x4, depth 0, reserve 1 switch; its candidates (both sides) ranked by the gated DODUO v2
arms.y: the same agent with the ungated candidates

miltank.equal_wall_clock: the gate runs inside the 1,000 ms decision budget (search.js starts the clock before the candidates are scored), so every millisecond the gate costs is a millisecond of playouts the gated arm does not get

amendment_2: 2026-09-25, after the seed-3 run on 685725dc (1,993/1,997 = 99.80%, 4 losses, all 4 clicks futile per their replays, but one of the four — a Wide Guard — was cut on dice luck: a partner's 30% flinch landed in both of the only two worlds where the foe used its spread move; and 6 joints in 1 decision were still cut by the pair gate on a MAG-dead click). Fixed: the secondary stream pinned high on the pinned worlds; each cover round on one dice regime so every opposing option meets both; a shield world is skipped only when the shield HELD and only for a click the shield can block (its `protect` flag); the pair gate's 'never tested' is no longer read as 'has an effect'. The confirmation is re-run on a FRESH draw, seed 4, and both arenas are re-run on the same code. The seed-3 run and the arenas played on 685725dc are reported as the previous version, not discarded.
